title: Cheese wedge with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Cheese wedge body -->
  <polygon points='15,75 85,75 85,60 15,30' fill='#FFD833'/>
  <!-- Top face of wedge -->
  <polygon points='15,30 85,60 85,50 15,20' fill='#FFE566'/>
  <!-- Side face -->
  <polygon points='15,30 15,75 85,75 85,60' fill='#F5C400'/>
  <!-- Holes -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='62' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#E0A800'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='68' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#E0A800'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='55' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#E0A800'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='45' rx='3.5' ry='2' fill='#E0A800'/>
  <!-- Smiling face -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='45' rx='4' ry='4.5' fill='#5A3500'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='50' rx='4' ry='4.5' fill='#5A3500'/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx='39.5' cy='43.5' r='1.5' fill='#FFF8CC'/>
  <circle cx='63.5' cy='48.5' r='1.5' fill='#FFF8CC'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M40,57 Q50,68 60,60' stroke='#5A3500' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='53' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#FF9966' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='57' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#FF9966' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
